name: Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd
summary: Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals in China. The company offers prescription drugs covering various therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular-cerebrovascular, tumor immunity, digestion and metabolism, and neuroscience; over-the-counter drugs; modern TCM; biological drugs; and chemical drugs. It also engages in medical instruments, agriculture, and chain drugstore activities. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Tasly Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd in May 2012.
